Maricopa County is committed to providing equal access to its programs, services, and activities.
To request an accommodation related to a disability for a County program, service, or activity, contact the ADA Compliance Program.

Requests related to public meetings should be made at least three (3) business days in advance when possible to allow time for coordination.
